_comment: PUBLIC commercial facts only. Every value traces to BrandSure_Master_Numbers_and_Language_Sheet.md via the 'source' key. Private facts (docs/SOURCE-OF-TRUTH.md §5.2) are absent by design and must never be added. Mirrors Supabase commercial_facts; guard rule 5 compares them once the Standard/Expert rename lands (docs/OPEN-ITEMS.md item 4).
_schema: each fact: { value, note, source, public }

agency_setup_fee.note: Mandatory. Layer 4 v4 §6 fixes the scope and, just as importantly, the exclusions.

agency_setup_scope.value: advertising account setup, conversion tracking, audience and campaign structure, and the initial creative set

agency_setup_excludes.value: no customer follow-up system, no product catalogue
agency_setup_excludes.note: Verbatim AG_SETUP_EXCLUDES. Agency setup does NOT include these; showing the scope without the exclusion is how Agency gets mistaken for Digital Partner.

digital_partner_setup_fee.note: Mandatory. Same fee as Agency, wider scope.

digital_partner_setup_scope.value: everything in the Agency setup, plus the foundation of the customer follow-up system and a basic best-seller catalogue built from information you already have, up to 50 products
digital_partner_setup_scope.note: Layer 4 v4 §6. The 50-product cap and 'from existing information' are both part of the scope — leaving either out oversells it. Say 'customer follow-up system'; the three-letter English acronym for it is developer language and Layer 4 v4 §3 keeps it out of client copy.

digital_partner_month_one.note: Month-1 cash to BrandSure. Ad money is separate and stays in the client's account

advertising_separate.value: Paid separately by your business. The amount is agreed together — there is no standard budget.
advertising_separate.note: REPLACES agency_adspend_range (₹50,000–₹2,00,000) and digital_partner_adspend_start (₹1,00,000/month), both removed in Chat 15. numbers.v2.js v2 removed DP_AD_START as a 'forbidden universal ₹1,00,000 advertising budget' and Layer 4 v4 §6 states there is no fixed advertising budget. A figure here is a build error, not a helpful hint — including a range, and including one labelled 'suggested'.

advertising_factors.value: city, product category, the products being promoted, the enquiry volume you want, the calling capacity available, and how ready the business is
advertising_factors.note: What the advertising amount is agreed against. Verbatim DP_AD_FACTORS.

digital_partner_capacity.value: 1 city · handling capacity for up to 300 new enquiry records a month
digital_partner_capacity.note: Layer 4 v4 §6: this is a HANDLING capacity, not a promise of 300 enquiries. It is not 300 enquiries generated, 300 qualified customers, 300 appointments, 300 showroom visits or 300 orders (DP_CAPACITY_NOT). Repeated calls or messages from one customer stay one record. Always rendered with capacity_qualifier.

capacity_qualifier.value: That is how many new enquiry records we can handle for you — not a promise of 300 enquiries, visits or orders.
capacity_qualifier.note: MUST be rendered wherever digital_partner_capacity appears. Derived from DP_CAPACITY_NOT.

digital_partner_breakeven.note: MUST be rendered with breakeven_qualifier. Layer 4 v4 §6: this covers the recurring ₹75,000 fee only, at an ASSUMED ₹15,000 contribution per order. It excludes setup, advertising, GST effects and every other cost. Label it an illustration; never call it business break-even.

breakeven_qualifier.value: An illustration of the monthly fee only, at an assumed profit of ₹15,000 an order. It leaves out setup, advertising, GST and your other costs, so it is not your business break-even.
breakeven_qualifier.note: MANDATORY alongside digital_partner_breakeven. components/figures.php and the count component enforce it.

digital_partner_profit_per_order.note: The profit-per-order figure the break-even example is built on. Illustrative, and stated as such wherever it appears — it is the owner's own margin, not a BrandSure number.

minimum_term.note: Agency and Digital Partner. Then month to month

growth_partnership_ads.value: BrandSure funds the agreed Google and Meta advertising under the Growth Partnership.
growth_partnership_ads.note: APPROVED PUBLIC WORDING (Override 1). The only commercial sentence permitted about Growth Partnership. No percentage, no term, no fee, no deposit.

growth_partnership_disclosure.value: The complete commercial structure is explained with your business numbers after a business review.

growth_partnership_progression.value: Product, pricing, showroom and business systems are introduced progressively, as your business becomes ready for each one.
growth_partnership_progression.note: REPLACES growth_partnership_stages, the public five-stage list (Foundation · Stability · Profit per Order · Scale · Stable at Scale), removed in Chat 15. Layer 4 v4 §4 retires it twice over: the public five-stage diagram is withdrawn, AND the five stages themselves were replaced by four private ones (Foundation · Optimisation · Scale · Stability) in numbers.v2.js. The public site therefore names no stages at all — a stage list invites the next question, which is how long each takes, and that is private.

client_result.value: A 26-year-old furniture business moved from about ₹45 lakh a month to ₹87 lakh+ a month in about 5 months.
client_result.note: MUST always be rendered together with client_result_footnote. The component enforces this; it is not optional.

client_result_footnote.value: One client result. Outcomes depend on product, city, budget and execution.
